class.name: MovementTickParams
class.brief_description: Everything a [MovementMode] is handed when it is time to move.
class.description: A single object rather than six arguments, so a mode written in GDScript has one thing to type and adding to it later does not break every mode.

method.name: get_component
method.description: The [CharacterMovementComponent] running this tick. Settings and [method CharacterMovementComponent.queue_next_mode] are reached through it.

method.name: get_component_2d
method.description: The [CharacterMovementComponent2D] running this tick, when the character is a 2D one. Exactly one of this and [method get_component] is set - a mode cannot be dimension-agnostic when the solver it calls is not.

method.name: get_delta
method.description: Length of this step in seconds. Not necessarily the frame time - a long frame is split into several steps.

method.name: get_input
method.description: What the player asked for this tick.

method.name: get_out_state
method.description: Where the mode writes its result. Arrives holding a copy of the starting state, so a mode that changes nothing is still correct.

method.name: get_proposed_move
method.description: The proposal [method MovementMode._generate_move] writes into and [method MovementMode._simulation_tick] reads.

method.name: get_sim_time_ms
method.description: Milliseconds of simulated time since the component started, taken from whichever component is set. A [LayeredMove] times itself against this rather than against the clock, so the same move behaves identically in 2D and 3D and survives being replayed.

method.name: get_start_state
method.description: The state the tick began from.

method.name: set_component
method.description: Sets the component running this tick.

method.name: set_component_2d
method.description: Sets the 2D component running this tick.

method.name: set_delta
method.description: Sets the length of this step.

method.name: set_input
method.description: Sets the input for this tick.

method.name: set_out_state
method.description: Sets the object the mode writes its result into.

method.name: set_start_state
method.description: Sets the state the tick begins from.
